privacy.title: Privacy & Cookies
privacy.subtitle: How this site uses data
privacy.cookiesBody: This website uses cookies to remember your preferences and to provide optional analytics. Essential functionality works without them.
privacy.analyticsBody: If you accept cookies, we use Umami—a privacy-friendly, open-source analytics tool—to understand how visitors use this site. No personal data is collected; we only see anonymized page views and events.
privacy.choicesBody: You can accept or decline analytics cookies using the banner at the bottom of the page. Your choice is stored locally and persists across visits.
